# 📮 ab-cloud · .github · ISSUE_TEMPLATE — Structured Issue Forms

> **Navigation:** [`ab-cloud`](../../README.md) › [`.github`](../README.md) › **`ISSUE_TEMPLATE`**

![Snapshot](https://img.shields.io/badge/AB--Cloud-snapshot%20v1.2.0-blue?style=flat-square&logo=dicebear&logoColor=white) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-IPL--RP--1.0-red?style=flat-square)

The AB-Cloud snapshot's own **YAML-driven issue forms**, preserved verbatim from the standalone repository `wild8highlander/ab-cloud-research` at v1.2.0. They structure bug reports and feature requests for the AB-Cloud suite (verification, monographs, apps, lab-3d) exactly as the parent snapshot used them. Note that these templates belong to the historical snapshot — active issue tracking for the whole repository happens at the top level via [`.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`](../../../.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/README.md).

## 📂 Contents — What Lives Here

| File | Size | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [`bug_report.yml`](bug_report.yml) | 1.3 KB | structured bug report form for the AB-Cloud suite |
| [`config.yml`](config.yml) | 241 B | template chooser config |
| [`feature_request.yml`](feature_request.yml) | 650 B | feature proposal form |
